subject: Re: MedixAI — confirmation: no model learning, retention & logging plan
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@medixai.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedixAI Legal <legal@medixai.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: MedixAI onboarding — training & retention questions

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick follow-up from the legal team: MedixAI requires an explicit, written commitment that data processed via Redwood will not be used to train or improve public or internal models (no derivative model training) unless we provide an explicit opt-in. We also need clarity on token-level logging, retention windows for request/response traces, and whether logs may leave the US region.

I've attached our completed security questionnaire for reference (see attachment). High-level asks:
- Written statement that Redwood will not use any customer-provided content to train models or to generate model derivatives without explicit opt-in.
- Retention policy for request/response logs and for audit trails; ability to set a custom retention (30/90/365 days).
- Confirmation that logs and any persisted telemetry for MedixAI will remain in the US region unless otherwise agreed.
- Process for requesting deletion and how long deletion takes across caches and backups.

Can you confirm in writing? If you have a standard "no-training" commitment doc we can circulate to Legal, that would be ideal.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Partnerships
MedixAI

--
Attachment: medixai-security-questionnaire-filled.pdf

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@medixai.com>
Cc: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: MedixAI onboarding — training & retention questions

Elena — great to hear from you and thanks for sending the questionnaire. Appreciate the clarity on requirements. Summary and commitments below; please treat this as Redwood's written confirmation for the scoped use-case described.

Summary of commitments (for MedixAI account RDW-2027-0483):
- No model training: Redwood will not use any MedixAI-provided content (requests, responses, attachments, or derived metadata) to retrain, fine-tune, or otherwise improve public or proprietary LLMs unless MedixAI provides an explicit, documented opt-in.
- Data residency: All processing and storage for MedixAI will be provisioned in the US region (us-west-2) by default; cross-region replication will not occur without a signed amendment.
- Logging & retention: Application-level logs and token-level request/response traces are retained for a configurable window. Default retention for MedixAI will be 90 days. Redwood can support 30/90/365-day options; please confirm which you prefer.
- Deletion & caches: Deletion requests will initiate removal from hot caches within 24 hours and will be reflected in active serving KV caches within 48 hours. Backups are purged according to the selected retention policy; final removal from cold backups may take up to 30 days depending on the backup schedule.
- Audit & attestation: We will include explicit "no-training" flags on MedixAI's tenant and produce an audit export showing flags and retention settings during provisioning.

I've attached our standard "no-model-training" commitment for signature. If Legal has minor redlines we can loop in contracts and our security team for a quick turnaround. Next steps I propose:
1) MedixAI picks a retention window (30/90/365).
2) Legal countersigns our no-training commitment (attachment).
3) We provision a US-only tenant and schedule a quick onboarding call (30 min) to confirm logging configuration and deletion flows.

If helpful, I'll ask product to enable the tenant-level "no-tuning" toggle and create a support runbook for deletion requests.

Thanks — talk soon.

Regards,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Schedule: https://cal.com/dylan-brooks/30

--
Attachment: rdw-no-model-training-commitment.docx

Date: Mon, 18 Apr 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: MedixAI onboarding — training & retention questions

Dylan,

Thanks for the clear summary. MedixAI is comfortable with the commitments you listed. Our legal team has countersigned the no-training commitment and attached the signed PDF. We'd like the retention window set to 90 days to start.

A couple of quick clarifications before we finalize:
- Can you provide the expected SLA for deletion confirmation once we submit a deletion request through support (not just the internal cache timings)? We need a confirmation ETA we can commit to internally.
- Will the tenant-level "no-tuning" flag appear on the onboarding console so our security admins can verify it visually?

I'll upload the countersigned PDF into our procurement ticket and loop procurement once we have the signed doc and the deletion SLA.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Partnerships
MedixAI

--
Attachment: medixai-countersigned-no-training.pdf

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@medixai.com>
Cc: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, MedixAI Legal <legal@medixai.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Apr 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: MedixAI onboarding — training & retention questions

Elena — thanks, and really appreciate the quick turnaround from your Legal team. Confirmations below:

- Deletion SLA: Once MedixAI files a formal deletion request via our support portal (support.redwood.ai/tickets), Redwood will provide an initial confirmation within 4 business hours. Full propagation (removal from hot caches and manifesting in tenant audit exports) typically completes within 48 hours; final purge from cold backup snapshots will be completed within 30 days. We'll include the ticket ID and a compliance report when the process completes.

- Console visibility: Yes — the tenant will show a visible "No model training / No tuning" toggle and a read-only audit field that records the date/time the flag was set. We'll include a screenshot in the onboarding checklist.

Operational next steps I will trigger today:
- Product: enable tenant-level no-tuning flag and add retention=90d to the tenant profile.
- Security: produce an initial audit export showing the flag and retention settings; we'll push to your Drive folder.
- Sales/Procurement: I'll share the countersigned doc and confirm steps for PO and procurement contact.

Proposed rollout: tenant standby on Apr 20, onboarding call Apr 21 (09:00 PT) — does that work for your team?

I'll also attach a short support runbook describing deletion request fields and the data elements we'll include in the compliance report.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
